body:
Part of #241 · Part of #153

## What
`pnpm run lint:docs` now has a second check: every repo-relative path cited in an opted-in doc must exist. One greppable line per hit (`DEAD PATH AGENTS.md:279 src/api/foo.ts`), exit 1.

- `scripts/hooks/docPathExists.logic.mjs` — pure extraction + check with an injected `exists()`. Citations are backticked path-like tokens (known root, or slash + known extension / trailing slash, or a bare top-level file name) and markdown link targets (resolved against the citing doc's directory). Ignored by design: fenced code blocks, globs, `<placeholders>`, URLs, `@/` aliases, `~`/absolute paths, `../` sibling repos. Per-line opt-out `<!-- allow-missing-path -->`, mirroring `allow-abs-path`.
- `scripts/check-doc-paths.mjs` — runs it on `PATH_EXISTENCE_FILES`; the absolute-path check is unchanged.
- ADR-0014 + one paragraph each in AGENTS.md §3 Step 2b, cursor rule 021, the CI step name.

## Why
REPO_MAP.md is the first structural doc an agent reads and 66 of its citations point nowhere (measured with this check). ADR-0010 made paths portable; nothing made them real.

## Scope note (deviation, with reason)
`PATH_EXISTENCE_FILES` is `['AGENTS.md']` here. AGENTS.md is already green (0 dead). REPO_MAP.md has 66 dead citations and fixing them pushed this PR to 454 reviewable lines, so the fixes are stacked in a second PR that also opts REPO_MAP.md in — the check is never red on `main`.

## Tests added (`scripts/hooks/docPathExists.logic.test.mjs`, 58 cases, fake filesystem)
extraction: known roots, directories, bare top-level files/dotfiles, bare directory shorthand, unknown-root paths with an extension or trailing slash, `./` stripping, links, anchors, `docDir` resolution, line numbers, per-line dedupe · ignore: 19 token shapes + 5 link shapes, fenced blocks, marker (and only the marked line), empty input · `findDeadPaths` (injected fs, no trailing slash, docDir) · `formatDeadPaths`.

## Definition of done (run in the worktree, rebased on `413e754`)
| command | exit | result |
|---|---|---|
| `pnpm run lint` | 0 | tsc -b + eslint clean |
| `pnpm run test:run` | 0 | 128 files, 1721 tests passed (baseline scripts suite 47 → 105) |
| `pnpm run build` | 0 | built in 6.48s |
| `pnpm run lint:docs` | 0 | clean |
| negative: `printf '\nSee `src/api/foo.ts`.\n' >> AGENTS.md; pnpm run lint:docs` | 1 | `DEAD PATH AGENTS.md:279 src/api/foo.ts` (reverted) |

Reviewable lines (excl. the test file): 263.

## Open questions
- Fenced tree diagrams are not scanned (they are illustrations, and indentation-to-path is fragile). REPO_MAP's "Current Structure" tree therefore stays a manual responsibility — flagged in ADR-0014; follow-up candidate if it drifts again.
- `@/…` alias specifiers are ignored (module specifiers, extension-less). Resolving them would need extension probing; not in this slice.
